figures.name: 17_rank_outcomes_and_examples
figures.title: Whole-query rank outcomes and selected retrieval examples at 650 kJ

summary_panel.direction: rank(Proposed) compared with rank(AFL-OTA); lower is better

figures.caption: Under the same 650 kJ active-energy budget, the upper panel shows ground-truth video rank improvements, ties and worsenings of Proposed relative to AFL-OTA over all 1,280 CapERA and 256 AirScape retained text queries. A lower rank is better; these percentages are paired rank outcomes, not Recall@1 or mR. The lower panels show selected text-to-video retrieval examples with three successes and one miss per dataset. Each method displays its top-ranked video; GT rank gives the annotated paired video rank in the full gallery. Green/red borders indicate correct/incorrect paired-video top1 retrieval. The selected mix does not estimate average success or forgetting quality.

figures.name: 18_all_comparator_rank_outcomes_1x2
figures.title: All-query rank outcomes: Proposed versus all comparators
figures.caption: Proposed GT-rank outcomes relative to each comparator over all retained text queries at the same 650 kJ active-energy budget. Improved, tied and worsened mean smaller, equal and larger paired-video rank, respectively. Each comparator bar sums to 100%. These are paired rank outcomes, not Recall@1, mR or independent-seed uncertainty. Proposed is the reference, so a self-comparison bar is omitted.

figures.name: 19_all_method_rank_boxplot_1x2
figures.title: All-method full-query GT-rank boxplots
figures.whisker_rule: 1.5 IQR, ending at the most extreme observed in-fence values
figures.caption: Distribution of annotated video ranks for all retained text queries under the same 650 kJ active-energy budget. Boxes show the 25th–75th percentiles with median lines; whiskers use 1.5 IQR and every outside value is plotted. Lower ranks are better. This is the query distribution from one development seed, not training-run confidence intervals. CapERA captions from the same video are not independent observations.
